sentence_stem: I did not answer your text message because
full_sentence: I did not answer your text message because my phone battery was dead.
acceptable_variants: I was in a meeting all day.

options.why_wrong: This expresses a feeling, not a reason for not answering, so it does not complete the cause clause.

options.text: I will answer it later today.
options.why_wrong: This describes a future plan, not a cause, so 'because' does not connect to it.
This gives a time, not a reason, so it does not explain the missed reply.

explanation: After 'because', we need a clause that gives the reason for the first part of the sentence. Learners should notice that 'because' is followed by a full clause with its own subject and verb.
translation: Eu não respondi à sua mensagem de texto porque a bateria do meu celular tinha acabado.
